messages:
michelle: Quick sync — Atlas (pilot customer) asked for an "optimize advisor" preview. They want three things: auto-batching guidance, cache/kv prefix recommendations, and quantization presets tied to model families. They also want eval-triggered alerts for quality regressions. Can we sketch a minimally shippable slice?

ahmed: Are we treating quantization recs as advisory (docs + UI) or as infra-applied profiles (server-side presets)? Big perf difference.

michelle: Start advisory + UI for pilot; infra-applied presets would be a follow-up if pilot shows strong ROI. Customer wants something they can run with in 2–4 weeks.

kai: For batching: we can ship heuristics + a per-route recommended batch size + a "safe" concurrency cap. Implementation: sampling of request size distribution -> recommend batch windows. Runtime change: minimal — we just expose suggested config in Console and via API.

sarah: Agree. Need to define acceptance criteria: pilot customers should see >=10% token-cost reduction without >10% increase in tail latency. Otherwise, not useful.

eva: For caching: recommend prefix caching rules + TTL suggestions per route. We can reuse existing KV cache primitives but need a UI to simulate hit-rate estimates for a given prefix. That simulation is medium effort.

michelle: Good call. Let's scope simulation out of M1 — provide heuristic expected-hit-rate based on sample traffic stats, not a full simulator.

lucas: Eval-triggered alerts: customers will want configurable checks. Proposed MVP: allow uploading a reference prompt set and set thresholds (e.g., perplexity, exact-match, or custom metric from eval run). When regression crosses threshold, send Slack/email and create an incident in Console.

ahmed: We need to be careful exposing eval metrics tied to model changes — must include model version pinning and a clear mapping between eval set and route. Also require RBAC for alerting.

michelle: Noted. MVP RBAC: only org admins can create eval-alert monitors. We can expand later.

kai: Minimal data flow for eval alerts: 1) eval job posts results to /evals 2) monitor compares metrics 3) if trigger -> create alert event (Console + webhook + slack). We can wire to existing alert infra.

product-bot: deploy-checklist: add feature flags for advisor-ui, eval-alerts, and batching-recs.

sarah: Launch gating checklist suggestion: 
- Feature flagged for 100% org opt-in
- Pilot doc + quickstart (10 min)
- Two pilot customers signed (Atlas + BetaCo)
- Acceptance: cost reduction >=10% (measured) OR detection of a regression within 24h of model rollout (for alerts)
- No security blockers (KMS/HSM not required for advisory)

michelle: Prioritization: we have 4 dev-weeks for the advisor UI + telemetry + basic backend. Eval-alert plumbing will need another 3 dev-weeks. Batching heuristics + docs = 2 dev-weeks. Cumulative: ~9 dev-weeks. Thoughts on reducing scope?

lucas: Can drop the Console simulation (hit-rate estimator) for alpha and provide a CLI tool that runs against sample logs to produce an expected hit rate. That saves UI time.

ahmed: Also defer per-model quant presets mapping. Ship generic quant profiles (fast, balanced, accurate) with recommended model classes mapped in docs. Later we can auto-suggest model-specific options.

michelle: OK final proposal for MVP slice: 
- Advisor UI (flagged) shows recommended batch size, cache prefix suggestions, and quant profile (fast/balanced/accurate) with rationale.
- CLI helper for cache hit-rate estimation (alpha).
- Eval-alerts: monitor creation UI (admins only) + webhook/slack notifications + Console incident link.
- Docs + 10-min quickstart + pilot onboarding checklist.

kai: Dev owners: 
- UI + advisor frontend: kai
- Backend endpoints + telemetry: ahmed
- Eval-alert plumbing + monitors: eva
- Docs + pilot runbook: michelle

sarah: Timeline proposal: deliver feature-flagged alpha to pilot orgs in 3 sprints (6 weeks). Ship GA-like roll after pilot feedback, ~10 weeks.

michelle: Customers to invite: Atlas (already interested), BetaCo (sales lead), and internal dogfood. I'll coordinate onboarding.

lucas: Risks: incorrect quant recs may cause quality issues; make sure docs strongly recommend A/B testing and model-pinning.

eva: Action items:
- kai: initial UI mockups by EOD Friday -> post in #design-review
- ahmed: stub backend routes + sample response schema -> PR branch by next Tue
- michelle: pilot runbook + invite emails -> draft by Mon
- eva: eval monitor prototype (bare webhook + alerting) -> PoC by next Thu

michelle: Thanks. If no objections, I'll file the roadmap ticket and attach this thread. :thumbsup:

kai: :thumbsup:

ahmed: lgtm

product-bot: reminder: Please add a ticket in Jira with label `optimize-advisor` and link to this thread.
